description:
Create a roadmap milestone on a property's task board. name and both dates are required — startDate and endDate are YYYY-MM-DD and must satisfy startDate <= endDate (a roadmap milestone is always scheduled). Optional: description and color (#RRGGBB hex). Assign tasks to it afterwards with assign_task_to_milestone. Dependencies between milestones are not set here.

Cost: 2 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// create a Q3 roadmap milestone with a start and end date.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","name":"Q3 Launch","startDate":"2026-07-01","endDate":"2026-09-30"}
```
name: create_milestone
title: Create milestone
